fact: UNFPA Djibouti lists the 73-page definitive-results report of the third census (RGPH-3) as published; the site's date reads 1 January 2026 and may be a system default.
The page describes RGPH-3 as conducted in 2024 by INSTAD, the previous census being 2009.
INSTAD states RGPH-3 data collection took place in April and May 2024, with provisional results published in June 2024.
The Joint Data Center refers to the 2024 census (RGPH3) as the basis for the EDAM5 survey sample.
